{{dablink|For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
'''White henpepper''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the area of [[Two Rivers]] and [[Amadicia]]. It is a soothing remedy for a toothache.

Another application for white henpepper is as a hair dye; a wash of the herb will turn hair black as night.{{ref/book|5|10}} [[Pokeleaf]] makes an effective wash for removing the color from white henpepper.{{ref/book|5|49}}
